GATE: J-F1 complete on the flight lots (ENG-HW-101-IN718 screws, HW-170 springs, LOCTITE 243): it sets the lot torque T_lot and carries the spring items (K with the spring under the head, the spring flattening, the crack-on torque) and the Fuji Prescale footprint item (TO-VERIFY) (hardware_v352 v1.7 HW-101 test). 1. inspect the hole edges and the bore per C1 (e); gauge the ten TC-01 holes with the pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62 and record each hole's size (ENG-TC-13 is selected to it; a hole that takes the 5.62 pin is rejected, C1 (g)); gauge the ten TC-02 taps M5-6H GO / NO-GO (cured locker removed by a thread chaser only, no re-tap); clean. 2. fit the ten ENG-TC-12 plugs in their numbered holes from outside, contour aligned, band on. 3. lubricate S01 and S02 with the selected lubricant (FKM- and N2O-compatible, TO-SELECT with a datasheet; oxygen-clean per the wetted-part rule); fit them into the TC-02 grooves with an even stretch over a cone, no twist (check the mould line). 4. clock TC-02 to the match marks BEFORE the rings enter the lead-in, then push it in axially without rotation until the head shoulder stands 2.00 +/-0.02 from the TC-01 forward end face on the gap gauge (rev-5 TC-02 tap note, TO-CONFIRM; TC-02 does not seat axially on TC-01, lead 16:53Z R4; v2 read 'until seated'). 5. remove the band and the plugs; look through each hole (10x loupe or borescope) for rubber debris or a cut ring; ANY debris: withdraw TC-02, replace both rings and repeat from step 1. 6. REGISTRATION (lead 17:55:55Z F2): fit the two GSE shoulder screws ENG-TC-13 (not flight), selected to the pin-gauged sizes of their holes, into two opposite holes before any flight screw. 7. fit the flight screws ONE AT A TIME into the other eight holes: a NEW ENG-HW-101-IN718 (M5 x 10.7 with spring A; M5 x 10.6 with spring B; never mixed in one joint) with a NEW HW-170 disc spring under the head (orientation per the ENG-HW-101-IN718 drawing, TO-DEFINE), LOCTITE 243 (flight lot) on the screw thread only, never on the spring or the flat; tighten to the J-F1 LOT TORQUE by method M-T1J (T_lot = 3750 N x K_min(lot) x 5 mm, so that the lot's K_min gives a maximum preload of 3750 N or less, lead 17:55:55Z F1; today's K window 0.1465-0.267: 2.747 N m, minimum 2057.6 N); record per hole: hole number and its pin size, screw and spring lot, torque, wrench (ID and calibration date). 8. remove the two shoulder screws LAST and replace each with a flight screw per step 7, recorded. 9. never re-torque a fitted screw; a screw removed for any reason is replaced by a new screw and a new spring (single-use, C6 (3)); removed screws are bagged and labelled with their hole number for the C6 (3) inspection; then the proof / leak test.
founder_rules.C6: (1) S01 and S02 are replaced after any FA-1-class event, together with the line-231 J-FWD inspection (lead 10:10Z rule). (2) Line-231 post-FA-1 inspection list: the ten J-FWD screws and their HW-170 disc springs replaced (new, single-use, (3)); the ten holes gauged for elongation and bearing set with the HW-101 pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62 (C1 (g)); a hole that takes the 5.62 pin is rejected; hole edges and the bore within 3 mm of a hole at 10x for nicks or raised metal; S01 / S02 replaced; the removed screws inspected per (3). (3) J-FWD screw life: SINGLE-USE founder rule until C6 closes (lead 16:53Z R3): the J-FWD screws are new at every assembly, never reused or re-torqued; removed screws are kept per hole and inspected at 10x plus dye penetrant at the thread root AND the head-to-shank fillet (LEAD ADDITION 18:36:37Z), as data. Both are quoted as negative, never as passing. Closure paths 2 (FE levers, (b1) / select-fit band after chain E) and 3 (qualification test, TO-DEFINE, founder) remain; path 1 (MJ thread) closed NOT SOURCED. HW-170 disc-spring reuse TO-RULE (Mechanical proposes: new with the screw at every assembly).
